source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "mobility as a service" OR "mobility-as-a-service" OR (MaaS AND transport)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"mobility as a service" OR "mobility-as-a-service" OR (MaaS AND transport),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("mobility as a service" OR "mobility-as-a-service" OR ("MaaS" AND "transport"))
